\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python", "from pgtask import Client, Task, TaskRegistry, Worker", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai_harness.pgtask import PGTaskDurability", "", "tasks = TaskRegistry(queue_name='agents')", "agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol', name='analyst', capabilities=[PGTaskDurability()])", "", "", "@tasks.task('analyse')", "async def analyse(task: Task, payload: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:", "    result = await agent.run(payload['prompt'])", "    return {'output': result.output}", "", "", "# Add a task to the queue.", "client = await Client.connect('postgresql://localhost/agents')", "await client.enqueue(analyse.request({'prompt': 'Summarize the Q3 report.'}))", "", "# Run tasks, usually in a separate process.", "await Worker('postgresql://localhost/agents', tasks).run()", "```"]
